comparison.objective: Place a nickel strip on a 2×2 battery pack and spot-weld it to all four cells; candidate rejects open cartons while allowing closed cartons to pass.
comparison.physical_skill: Thin-strip alignment, tool pickup, repeated dual-probe placement and controlled contact dwell versus moving-carton interception, flap avoidance, sidewall grasping and level transport.
comparison.success_condition: Requires strip pose within 3 mm/10°, four localized 0.2 s probe contacts, tool return and a 1 s released stable finish; candidate requires spill-free reject placement with 3 s dwell and untouched normal-carton passage.
comparison.reason: Localized strip placement and repeated welding-tool contacts are materially different from state-conditioned conveyor removal. Earlier specs vary partial-score weights and final stability details, but every supplied version remains clearly unrelated to the candidate.
